items.dek: With military haircuts and moustaches, the US sailors stood out against the flip-flops of the usual Pattaya crowd, writes the BBC's Jonathan Head.

items.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
items.dek: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.
